description: Generic, industry-agnostic process-governance checks (C7). Organisations replace or extend these rules with their own policy/regulatory requirements — the checker is rule-driven, not hard-coded.

rules.desc: The process has an explicit start event
The process has an explicit end event
An approval/authorization control step is present
An auditable record/log/archive step is present
Stakeholders are notified of the outcome
Alternative/decision paths are modelled (process is not purely linear)
The process has a single start event (7PMG G3)
The process has a single end event (7PMG G3)
The model stays small enough to understand (7PMG G1/G7: <= 50 elements)
Avoid OR (inclusive) routing where possible (7PMG G5)
